opportunities.name: Company account brief (SEC 10-K + Wikipedia, emailed)
opportunities.description: For a given ticker, find the latest 10-K filing date on SEC EDGAR, look up the company's HQ, employee count and CEO on Wikipedia, then email a one-line account brief to the account owner.
steps: Open SEC EDGAR company search and enter the ticker
Select the matching company from the suggestions
Filter filings by Form and open the latest 10-K annual report; note its filing date
Search Wikipedia for the company name and open the company article
Read HQ, number of employees and CEO from the infobox
Compose an email to the recipient with subject 'Account brief: <Company> (<TICKER>)'
Write the body '<Company>: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>.' and send (or save the draft)

instances.values: SNOW / Snowflake -> dana@example.com (HQ Menlo Park, 9,060 employees, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy, 10-K 2026-03-20)
DDOG / Datadog -> dana@example.com (HQ New York City, 8,100 employees, CEO Olivier Pomel, 10-K 2026-02-18)
HUBS (HubSpot) — got as far as opening the 10-K; Wikipedia and email steps not seen

opportunities.name: Supplier quote comparison in USD + supplier local time, emailed to procurement
opportunities.description: Convert two supplier quotes in foreign currencies to USD on Xe, pick the cheaper one, look up the current local time in the supplier's city on timeanddate, then email the summary to procurement.
steps: Open the Xe currency converter
Enter quote amount A, set its currency to currency A, set the target to USD, click Convert, and note the USD value
Enter quote amount B, set its currency to currency B, and note the USD value
Pick the currency whose quote is cheaper in USD
On timeanddate World Clock, search for the supplier city and note its current local time
Compose an email to procurement@example.com with subject 'Quotes: <item>'
Write the body '<amtA> <curA> = <usdA> USD, <amtB> <curB> = <usdB> USD, cheaper: <cur>. Supplier time in <city>: <time> <tz>.' and send (or save the draft)

instances.values: CNC enclosures: 12500 EUR vs 1950000 JPY, Osaka -> procurement@example.com (cheaper: JPY)
Shipping boxes: 8200 GBP vs 780000 INR, Pune -> procurement@example.com (cheaper: INR)
Item unknown: 64000 CNY vs 14500 (second currency being chosen); stops before the city/email steps

opportunities.name: Cross-office meeting sync check (time difference + holidays), emailed to ops
opportunities.description: For two cities and a month, find the time difference with the timeanddate Time Zone Converter, look up the second country's holidays in that month, then email ops the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate > Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Search for and add city A
Search for and add city B; note how far ahead or behind city B is
Go to Calendar > Holidays, then pick city B's country from the alphabetical list
Open that country's holidays for the current year, filter to the target month, and note the holiday dates
Compose an email to ops@example.com with subject 'Sync: <City A> / <City B>, <Month>'
Write the body '<City B> is <offset> ahead from <City A>. Avoid: <dates>.' and send (or save the draft)

instances.values: San Francisco / Bangalore, India, October -> ops@example.com (+12h30; avoid Oct 2, Oct 20)
New York / Berlin, Germany, December -> ops@example.com (+6h; avoid Dec 25, Dec 26)
